cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Help me write the complaint as a colleague, not my parent. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then leave the angry sentence. That's my contribution.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put both our names under it, not 'on behalf of.'

mechanism: A runs a joint complaint while bargaining over editing so B help can establish colleagues instead of parent and dependent.
confusable: Ordinary proofreading lacks the relational shift expressed through ownership and joint authorship.
comparison: Unlike table-moving friends, this alternative makes professional authorship and publicly shared responsibility the pressure.
seedUse: Complaint seed supplies spelling and joint signatures; S02 consultation seed informs yielding editing power while retaining the lead.
